outcome: Placental transporter expression (GLUT1, SNAT2, P-glycoprotein, BCRP)
Maternal blood nutrient levels (free amino acids, glucose, free fatty acids, cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, triglycerides)
Umbilical cord blood nutrient levels (free amino acids, glucose, free fatty acids, cholesterol, HDL, LDL, VLDL, triglycerides)
cohort: The study included mothers with singleton term (>37 weeks) C-section pregnancies conceived either naturally or by intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI), along with their umbilical cord blood.
finding: ICSI is associated with downregulated placental SNAT2 protein expression, increased placental proliferation and apoptotic rates, increased umbilical cord blood citrulline, and decreased umbilical cord blood free fatty acid levels in term pregnancies.
